reason: The cited evidence shows that grain refinement can accelerate protective scale formation (E3) and that surface processing reducing grain size lowers oxidation kinetics (E5), but it does not support the specific claim that Ti segregates to grain boundaries to form non-protective oxides, nor does it directly link grain boundary reduction to improved scale adhesion in this alloy system. E2 and E4 discuss elemental interactions and oxidation behavior in different compositions and conditions, providing only indirect context.
